title: The Ambulances
hook: Two customers, one requirement. I listened to the louder one. What showed up could not do the job.

title: The Hand Sanitizer
hook: An outbreak hits a deployed base. Legal calls individual sanitizer bottles a personal convenience item. The mission says otherwise.

title: The Parking Garage
hook: Counsel says employee parking is a personal expense. Leadership wants the whole garage anyway, and they brought a GAO cite.
